opis: Hedgehog's BIRTHDAY PARTY at the big wooden kitchen table from the reference picture, warm afternoon light through the window, a few colourful paper streamers and balloons by the window. On the table in the middle a round birthday CAKE with pink icing; on top of it EXACTLY THREE red RASPBERRIES and EXACTLY THREE thin candles, their little flames just blown sideways and going out, with tiny wisps of smoke. The little HEDGEHOG stands on a chair at the table, cheeks puffed out, blowing the candles out with all his might, eyes shut with joy. The BEAR stands on one side clapping his paws, beaming; the SQUIRREL on the other side throws a handful of confetti. EXACTLY THREE small plates on the table, one in front of each of them, and a little red toy drum with two drumsticks beside the hedgehog's plate. Happy, warm, festive.
